---
title: "Coverage map"
---

Two views of the same coverage data are available from the layer control at
the top right. **Provinces and territories** (default): click a jurisdiction
to see the models recorded for it. **Ecozones**: click an ecozone to see the
models recorded for a province or territory it overlaps. A filled area has at
least one model; the fill does not show an exact model footprint or imply a
recommendation. The largely unforested Arctic ecozones (Arctic Cordillera,
Northern Arctic and Southern Arctic) are not shown. Where a model applies only to part of a jurisdiction, the
region is noted in the popup. Coverage is summarized here and may be out of
date; confirm details on each model's website.

```{=html}
<style>
.leaflet-container {
  background: #edf2ef;
}
</style>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
source("R/registry.R")
source("R/site_helpers.R")
source("R/geo.R")

canada <- st_read("data/geospatial/canada/ca.shp", quiet = TRUE)
ecozones <- st_read("data/geospatial/ecozones/ecozones.gpkg", quiet = TRUE)
province_ecozones <- read_registry_csv("data/geospatial/ecozones/province_ecozones.csv")
coverage <- read_registry_table("model_coverage")
models <- read_registry_table("models")
model_names <- stats::setNames(models$model_name, models$model_id)

# Provinces/territories each ecozone overlaps (data/geospatial/ecozones/province_ecozones.csv).
ecozone_provinces <- split(province_ecozones$jurisdiction_code, province_ecozones$ecozone_code)

# Per-row ecozone claims and whether each coverage row is province-wide (blank ecozones).
coverage_ecozones_list <- lapply(coverage$ecozones, split_multi)
coverage_is_provincewide <- lengths(coverage_ecozones_list) == 0L

# Coverage rows for one ecozone: province-wide rows for a jurisdiction it
# overlaps, plus rows that list it explicitly.
claims_for_ecozone <- function(ecozone_code) {
  jurisdictions <- ecozone_provinces[[ecozone_code]]
  if (is.null(jurisdictions)) {
    jurisdictions <- character()
  }
  provincewide <- coverage_is_provincewide & coverage$jurisdiction_code %in% jurisdictions
  explicit <- vapply(coverage_ecozones_list, function(x) ecozone_code %in% x, logical(1))

  provincewide_rows <- coverage[provincewide, , drop = FALSE]
  provincewide_rows$scope <- "province-wide"
  explicit_rows <- coverage[explicit, , drop = FALSE]
  explicit_rows$scope <- "listed"

  claims <- rbind(provincewide_rows, explicit_rows)
  claims[order(model_names[claims$model_id]), , drop = FALSE]
}

canada$jurisdiction_code <- substring(canada$id, 3L)
if (any(!grepl("^CA[A-Z]{2}$", canada$id)) || anyDuplicated(canada$jurisdiction_code)) {
  stop("Unexpected province or territory IDs in the Canada boundary file.")
}

popup_for <- function(jurisdiction_code, jurisdiction_name) {
  claims <- coverage[
    coverage$jurisdiction_code == jurisdiction_code,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  claims <- claims[order(model_names[claims$model_id]), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(claims) == 0) {
    return(as.character(tags$div(
      tags$h4(jurisdiction_name),
      tags$p("No models recorded.")
    )))
  }

  claim_items <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(claims)), function(i) {
    claim <- claims[i, ]
    details <- c(
      if (!is.na(claim$region_detail) && nzchar(claim$region_detail)) {
        paste0("Region: ", claim$region_detail)
      },
      if (!is.na(claim$stand_scope) && nzchar(claim$stand_scope)) {
        paste0("Stands: ", claim$stand_scope)
      }
    )

    tags$li(
      tags$strong(shown(model_names[[claim$model_id]])),
      if (length(details) > 0) {
        tagList(tags$br(), paste(details, collapse = " | "))
      }
    )
  })

  as.character(tags$div(
    tags$h4(jurisdiction_name),
    tags$p("Models recorded for this jurisdiction; regional qualifiers apply."),
    tags$ul(class = "mb-0", tagList(claim_items))
  ))
}

popup_for_ecozone <- function(ecozone_code, ecozone_name) {
  claims <- claims_for_ecozone(ecozone_code)

  if (nrow(claims) == 0) {
    return(as.character(tags$div(
      tags$h4(ecozone_name),
      tags$p("No models recorded.")
    )))
  }

  claim_items <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(claims)), function(i) {
    claim <- claims[i, ]
    label <- paste0(
      shown(model_names[[claim$model_id]]), " \u2014 ", claim$jurisdiction_code,
      if (identical(claim$scope, "province-wide")) " (province-wide)"
    )
    details <- if (!is.na(claim$region_detail) && nzchar(claim$region_detail)) {
      paste0("Region: ", claim$region_detail)
    }

    tags$li(
      tags$strong(label),
      if (!is.null(details)) tagList(tags$br(), details)
    )
  })

  as.character(tags$div(
    tags$h4(ecozone_name),
    tags$p(paste(
      "Models recorded for a province or territory this ecozone overlaps;",
      "regional qualifiers apply. Province-wide entries are listed for every",
      "ecozone the province overlaps; they may not apply throughout this",
      "ecozone."
    )),
    tags$ul(class = "mb-0", tagList(claim_items))
  ))
}

coverage_codes <- unique(coverage$jurisdiction_code)
canada$has_claims <- canada$jurisdiction_code %in% coverage_codes
canada$model_count <- vapply(canada$jurisdiction_code, function(code) {
  length(unique(coverage$model_id[coverage$jurisdiction_code == code]))
}, integer(1))
canada$fill_color <- ifelse(canada$has_claims, "#477b70", "#d8dedb")
canada$click_label <- paste0(
  canada$name,
  " - ",
  canada$model_count,
  ifelse(canada$model_count == 1, " model", " models")
)
popups <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(canada)), function(i) {
  popup_for(canada$jurisdiction_code[[i]], canada$name[[i]])
}, character(1))

ecozones$model_count <- vapply(ecozones$ecozone_code, function(code) {
  length(unique(claims_for_ecozone(code)$model_id))
}, integer(1))
ecozones$has_claims <- ecozones$model_count > 0
ecozones$fill_color <- ifelse(ecozones$has_claims, "#477b70", "#d8dedb")
ecozones$click_label <- paste0(
  ecozones$name_en,
  " - ",
  ecozones$model_count,
  ifelse(ecozones$model_count == 1, " model", " models")
)
ecozone_popups <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(ecozones)), function(i) {
  popup_for_ecozone(ecozones$ecozone_code[[i]], ecozones$name_en[[i]])
}, character(1))

leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 2, maxZoom = 7)) |>
  setView(lng = -96, lat = 59, zoom = 3) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = canada,
    group = "Provinces and territories",
    layerId = ~jurisdiction_code,
    label = ~click_label,
    popup = popups,
    popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 420, minWidth = 240),
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    fillColor = ~fill_color,
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#263d38",
      fillOpacity = 0.95,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = ecozones,
    group = "Ecozones",
    layerId = ~ecozone_code,
    label = ~click_label,
    popup = ecozone_popups,
    popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 420, minWidth = 240),
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    fillColor = ~fill_color,
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#263d38",
      fillOpacity = 0.95,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  # One shared legend: addLegend's `group` option does not hide/show a legend
  # when switching *base* layers (only overlay groups), so the wording below
  # is kept generic enough to apply to both the province and ecozone views.
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    colors = c("#477b70", "#d8dedb"),
    labels = c("Model(s) recorded", "No model recorded"),
    title = "Registry coverage",
    opacity = 0.85
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Provinces and territories", "Ecozones"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```
